patterns.note: A dark-themed hero section with a central, high-impact headline and supporting data visualization cards, setting a performance-oriented tone.
Alternating dark and light background sections are used consistently to delineate content blocks, maintaining a full-width structure for all major sections.
Prominent use of large, bold sans-serif headings for section titles, often in white against dark backgrounds or dark against light, creating strong visual hierarchy.
A high-contrast palette of dark charcoal/black, pure white, and vibrant red/orange accents for CTAs and key information, with yellow used for specific data points.
A sticky header system that initially includes a promotional banner and main navigation, then transitions to a compact, streamlined main navigation bar upon scrolling down the page.
Content sections and individual elements (like cards or data points) animate into view with a subtle fade-up or slide-up effect as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic content flow.
Integration of detailed data visualizations and performance metrics directly within content sections to illustrate product benefits and provide tangible proof points.

technique_notes: A sticky header is implemented where an initial top banner and primary navigation are present, then upon scrolling, the banner disappears and the main navigation bar shrinks and fixes to the top of the viewport.

Scroll-triggered animations, likely using css-keyframes, reveal content sections and individual elements by fading them in and subtly translating them upwards as they enter the viewport, enhancing engagement.

The design utilizes a dark, textured background for the hero and footer sections to add depth, while interior content sections alternate between solid dark and light backgrounds to clearly separate information blocks.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with clear, readable body text and smaller, often uppercase labels for data points and sub-headings.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (e.g., 4-8px) on buttons, cards, and input fields, providing a soft, modern feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, particularly in the hero section and between major content blocks, with comfortable but not overly dense spacing for elements within sections.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a dark, high-contrast theme combined with integrated, visually engaging data visualizations and performance metrics. It effectively communicates complex athletic data in an accessible and motivating way, making the product's value immediately clear and compelling.
